chunks: It was narrated to me by Ali ibn Ahmad who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Ja'far who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Bashir who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Isa al-Damighani who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from the one who narrated to him from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah did not reveal these verses except for the Qadiris
Surely the guilty are in error and distress. On the day when they shall be dragged upon their faces into the fire; taste the touch of Hell. Surely We have created everything according to a measure.

key_terms.الْقَدَرِیَّهِ: The Qadiris, a theological sect emphasizing divine power and human ability in action
key_terms.سَقَرَ: Saqar, a specific level or name of Hellfire

ai.seo_question: Who are the Qadiris and what Quranic verses are revealed for them?
ai.summary: This narration from *Thawab al-A'mal* highlights the theological debate between the Qadariyyah (who emphasized human free will) and the Ahl al-Bayt's view on divine decree (*al-Qadar*). By linking the phrase 'bi-qadar' (according to a measure) in the cited verses to this sect, the Imam underscores that their specific understanding of agency was a distinct doctrinal position, using the Quranic description of their punishment to validate the orthodox Shia stance on the interplay of divine will and human action.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. It was narrated to me by Ali b. Ahmad who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ja’far who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Basheer who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Isa al-Damighani who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Khalid al-Barqi from Yunis b. Abdulrahman from the one the person that narrated to him from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“Following verses are revealed only for the Qadiris:
“Surely the guilty are in error and distress. On the day when they shall be dragged upon their faces into the fire; taste the touch of Hell. Surely We have created everything according to a measure.”
